(i) members in a group tend to communicate with each other more than they do with members in other groups, (ii), members of a rising group are more likely cohesive than members of other groups, (iii) members of a rising or falling group are more likely evenly communicating than members of other group, and (v) members of a falling group are more like to be not communicating than members of a rising, or other groups.
